name: Mam ca com
summary: Mắm cá cơm is the anchovy sauce at Chợ Hội An, salted from fish off Cửa Đại and Cù Lao Chàm. Spoon it on hot rice, or use it as a dip.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 market article calls it the best-known sauce in the market. The same article names mắm cá nục, mắm thính cá chuồn, cá trích, mắm dưa, and mắm cà pháo, and does not give those a method.
taste: The article says the town’s sauces are not too salty and not too sweet, and that they are hot.
howToEat: Spoon it onto a bowl of hot rice and mix.
Or boil hyacinth beans, or garden greens, and dip.
The same article rolls slices of grilled veal, herbs, and this sauce in rice paper, with a green chili. It also says that plate wants Hội An mắm nêm.
where: Chợ Hội An. A stall number and the hour are Check on arrival.
